---
title: "MVP Graphs"
author: "Janelle, German, and Marcus"
output: pdf_document
---
Passing Yards by Season Graph
```{r}
nfl_data <- read.csv("candidates_21-25.csv")
mvp_color <- ifelse(nfl_data$mvp == 1, "green", "blue")
mvp_pch <- ifelse(nfl_data$mvp ==1, 19, 1)
plot(nfl_data$season, nfl_data$pass_yds, xlab = "Season", ylab = "Passing Yards", main = "Passing Yards by Season", col = mvp_color, pch = mvp_pch)

```
